nodes.description: Contract owner address, set once in the constructor and used for fee payout and access control.
mapping(address => uint8[]) listing the countries owned by each player.
address[178] fixed array mapping each country index to its current owner.
Dynamic array of every address that ever bought a country.
Accumulated Ether pot funded by buyCountry payments.
Last pseudo-random value derived from block.blockhash and player country counts.
Address of the winner of the most recently finished game.
Number of countries a player must hold to win the game.
address[10] ring buffer of the last 5 winners and 5 losers.
msg.sender: caller identity used as player, attacker, owner check and payout index.
Risk() constructor that assigns the deployer as owner.
payable buyCountry(uint8): asserts price 10 finney, registers country ownership and player.
attackCountry(uint8): moves countries between attacker and defender based on blockhash randomness, then calls isGameEnd.
Public isGameEnd(): checks winnerLimit, pays out 90%/10% of the pot, resets all game state.
setwinnerLimit(uint8): owner-restricted setter of the win threshold.
Constant getter returning the full ownerofCountry array.
Constant getter returning totalmoney.
Constant getter returning playerCountries[ax][bx].
Constant getter returning the number of countries owned by ax.
Constant getter exposing the last pseudo-random value lastR.
Constant getter returning the winnerloser array.
Constant getter returning lastgameendWinner.
totalmoney += msg.value unchecked accumulation of Ether in the pot.
playerCountries[msg.sender].push(countryID) unbounded dynamic array growth.
ownerofCountry[countryID] = msg.sender unvalidated array index write.
lastR = uint256(block.blockhash(block.number-1)) % (a+b): miner-influenceable randomness and modulo of a+b.
winner.transfer(totalmoney/10*9) external Ether send to a player-controlled address.
owner.transfer(totalmoney/10) external Ether send to the contract owner.
Integer arithmetic totalmoney/10*9 and totalmoney/10 used for the payout split.
playerCountries[defender].length = 0 direct storage array length overwrite.
Unbounded for-loop that copies every country of one player to another and rewrites ownerofCountry.
assert(msg.sender == owner) manual authorization check in setwinnerLimit.
Loop zeroing ownerofCountry[i] and calling playerCountries[ownerofCountry[i]].length=0, including address(0).
countryID parameter of buyCountry: index of the country being purchased.
countryID parameter of attackCountry: index of the country being attacked.
x parameter of setwinnerLimit: new win threshold.
ax parameter of getaddr: owner address to query.
bx parameter of getaddr: country slot to query.
ax parameter of len: owner address to query.
Local attacker = msg.sender in attackCountry.
Local defender = ownerofCountry[countryID] in attackCountry.
Local a = number of countries owned by the attacker.
Local b = number of countries owned by the defender.
Function-scoped loop counter i used by the winnerloser shift loops and the copy loops.
Local loopcount holding the number of countries to transfer in attackCountry.
Local loopcount = playerList.length in isGameEnd.
Local winner, initialized to owner and overwritten when a player reaches winnerLimit.
Local boolean del flag that triggers the payout/reset branch.
Loop counter i in isGameEnd (uint8 for the player scan, reused for the reset loops).

normalization_plan.reason: countryID is a transient argument used only to index ownerofCountry and playerCountries inside buyCountry.
countryID is a transient argument used only to select the defender inside attackCountry.
x is a transient argument written directly into winnerLimit by setwinnerLimit.
ax is a transient lookup key of the constant getter getaddr.
bx is a transient inner-array index of the constant getter getaddr.
ax is a transient lookup key of the constant getter len.
attacker is a short-lived alias of msg.sender used only within attackCountry.
defender is a short-lived alias of ownerofCountry[countryID] used only within attackCountry.
a is only consumed as part of the (a+b) modulo divisor in the pseudo-random draw.
b is only consumed as part of the (a+b) modulo divisor in the pseudo-random draw.
i is a reused function-scoped loop counter in attackCountry.
loopcount only bounds the unbounded country-transfer loop.
loopcount only bounds the player scan inside isGameEnd.
winner is only consumed as the recipient of the external Ether transfer.
del is a transient boolean that selects the payout/reset branch of isGameEnd.
i is the loop counter driving the state-reset loop of isGameEnd.
